auth.noOfficialAffiliation: No Official Affiliation Unless Explicitly Stated
auth.collegenzNotAffiliated: CollegenZ is not affiliated, endorsed, or partnered with any of the colleges listed on the platform unless explicitly mentioned otherwise. The colleges listed are independent educational institutions, and their presence on our platform does not imply any formal partnership or endorsement.
auth.buildingPlatformForColleges: We are building a platform to enable colleges to launch their own digital tokens for campus economies. Until a college officially partners with us, any mining activity for that college is speculative and represents an early opportunity to potentially earn tokens if and when that college joins the platform.
auth.finalDecisionRights: Final decision rights for all token-related matters, including distribution, governance, and utility, belong exclusively to the respective colleges. CollegenZ serves as a facilitator and technology provider.
auth.tokensMinedVsCollegeCoins: Tokens Mined vs. College Coins: Not 1:1
auth.tokensNotSameAsCollegeCoins: The "tokens" you mine on CollegenZ are not the same as the actual college coins that will be issued when a college partners with us. Your mined tokens represent your proportional share of the total allocated college coins.
auth.collegeXyzAllocates: College XYZ allocates 1,000,000 college coins for miners
auth.youMinedTokens: You mined 2,000,000 tokens (20% of total mined)
auth.youWillReceiveCoins: You will receive 200,000 college coins (20% of allocated amount)
auth.yourShareCalculated: Your share is calculated as: (Your Mined Tokens / Total Mined Tokens) × Total Allocated College Coins
auth.usersReceiveAirdrops: Users who mine tokens for a college will receive their allocated college coins as airdrops after the college officially partners with CollegenZ and launches their digital token.
auth.timingDependsOnCollege: The timing of the airdrop depends entirely on when and if the college decides to partner with us. There is no guaranteed timeline, and some colleges may never partner with us.
auth.miningNowRepresents: Mining now represents an early opportunity to earn tokens at a higher rate. As colleges progress through different stages of partnership, the mining rate will be systematically reduced to reward early miners.
auth.waitlistStage: Waitlist Stage: Rate halved to 50% when college joins our waitlist
auth.liveStage: Live Stage: Rate halved again to 25% when college coins go live
auth.exchangeListing: Exchange Listing: Rate halved again to 12.5% when listed on InTuition Exchange
auth.miningStopped: Mining Stopped: No further mining allowed after exchange listing
auth.halvingScheduleDesigned: The halving schedule is designed to reward early believers who took the risk of mining before a college officially partnered with us. As the college progresses and risk decreases, the rewards also decrease proportionally. This ensures fair distribution and incentivizes early participation.
auth.eachCollegeHasFifteenMonths: Each college has 15 months from the start of the first mining session to officially sign up and partner with CollegenZ. This timeline is tracked individually for each college.
auth.ifCollegeDoesNotSignUp: If a college does not sign up within this timeframe, miners for that college will have the option to convert their mined tokens to TUIT, CollegenZ's native platform token.
auth.conversionRateDetermined: The conversion rate from college-specific tokens to TUIT will be determined at the time of conversion and will not be a fixed 1:1 ratio.
auth.totalTokensMinedForCollege: Total tokens mined for that college
auth.platformTokenomicsAtTime: Platform tokenomics at time of conversion
auth.noGuaranteeTuitConversion: There is no guarantee that the TUIT conversion will be favorable or that TUIT will have any specific market value. Mining is speculative, and miners accept the risk that a college may never partner with us, requiring conversion to TUIT at rates determined by market conditions.
auth.platformWelcomesStudents: Our platform welcomes students, alumni, fans, and supporters of any college. You don't need to be currently enrolled or have official college affiliation to participate in mining tokens. We believe in building inclusive communities around colleges.
auth.allUsersMustCompleteKyc: All users must complete Know Your Customer (KYC) verification before they can:
auth.kycLegalRequirement: KYC is a legal requirement to comply with anti-money laundering (AML) regulations and prevent fraudulent activity. Failure to complete KYC will result in inability to access your earned tokens outside the platform.
auth.whileWeWelcomeAllCommunity: While we welcome all community members to participate in mining, proof of college association may be required in certain circumstances, such as before withdrawal or for accessing specific benefits. However, this requirement may vary based on the college's policies and the nature of your participation.
auth.documentationShowingConnection: Documentation showing connection to the college community
auth.allDocumentsMustBeOfficial: All documents must be official, verifiable, and clearly show your name and the college name. Fake or forged documents will result in permanent account suspension and forfeiture of all mined tokens.
auth.importantCollegesRetainFinalAuthority: Important: Colleges retain final authority over eligibility criteria and token distribution. They may impose additional requirements or restrictions at their discretion.
auth.collegeAdministratorsMustVerify: College administrators who sign up to manage their institution's presence on CollegenZ must verify their management rights and official capacity. We are implementing a rigorous verification process and will begin authenticating all college admins before they join our waitlist.
auth.proofOfAdministrativeRole: Proof of administrative role (employment letter, faculty ID)
auth.videoVerificationCallWithTeam: Video verification call with our team
auth.miningTokensSpeculative: Mining tokens on CollegenZ is speculative and involves significant risk. There is no guarantee that any college will partner with us, that tokens will have any value, or that you will be able to withdraw or exchange your tokens. You may lose all the time and effort invested in mining. Only participate if you understand and accept these risks.
auth.finalAuthorityAllUltimateDecisions: Final Authority: All ultimate decisions regarding token distribution, utility, governance, and eligibility rest exclusively with the respective colleges. CollegenZ acts as a technology provider and cannot override college decisions.
auth.byUsingCollegenzPlatform: By using the CollegenZ platform, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to all the terms and conditions outlined on this page.

howOftenCanIMine.question: How often can I mine tokens?
howOftenCanIMine.answer: You can mine tokens once every 24 hours. The more consecutive days you mine, the higher your mining streak and potential bonuses.

areTheseRealTokens.question: Are these real cryptocurrency tokens?
areTheseRealTokens.answer: Currently, these are interest tokens that represent community engagement. When your college admin configures the token and launches it, these may be converted to actual blockchain tokens.

canISwitchCollege.question: Can I switch to a different college?
canISwitchCollege.answer: Yes, but switching colleges will reset your mining progress and tokens. We recommend staying with your favorite college for the best experience.

isThereACost.question: Is there a cost to participate?
isThereACost.answer: No! Mining tokens is completely free. We never ask for payment or credit card information from participants.

whatIfIMissDay.question: What happens if I miss a day of mining?
whatIfIMissDay.answer: Your streak will reset, but you won't lose your accumulated tokens. You can start building your streak again from day one.

howSecureIsInfo.question: How secure is my information?
howSecureIsInfo.answer: We use industry-standard encryption and security practices. We never share your personal information without your consent.

referralLimit.question: Is there a limit to how many referrals I can make?
referralLimit.answer: You can refer unlimited friends, but bonus rates are calculated based on up to 10 referrals per college. Referrals beyond 10 still count toward your total community, but won't increase your mining rate.

howItWorksColleges.caseStudy3Quote: This platform provides the perfect bridge between student interest and actual token deployment.
howItWorksColleges.faq1Question: What is the cost to participate?
howItWorksColleges.faq1Answer: The platform is completely free for colleges during the beta phase. We help you build student engagement at no cost while you prepare for token launch.
howItWorksColleges.faq2Question: How do we verify our college admin status?
howItWorksColleges.faq2Answer: You must sign up with an official college email address and provide your position/title. Our team reviews applications within 24-48 hours.
howItWorksColleges.faq3Question: Can we customize our token parameters later?
howItWorksColleges.faq3Answer: Yes! You can update token name, supply, use cases, and other parameters at any time before the official launch.
howItWorksColleges.faq4Question: What data do we get access to?
howItWorksColleges.faq4Answer: You can see student mining activity, demographics, referral networks, engagement metrics, and export all data to CSV for analysis.
howItWorksColleges.faq5Question: How do we launch the actual token?
howItWorksColleges.faq5Answer: Once you've configured your token and built sufficient student interest, we provide guidance on blockchain deployment and token distribution.
howItWorksColleges.faq6Question: What if students leave or graduate?
howItWorksColleges.faq6Answer: Student accounts remain active as long as they maintain engagement. Graduated students can optionally keep their tokens or transfer them.
